fullPassage:
Museums are said to be places where time is transformed into space. Maybe that's why people visit them, to learn and be inspired in new ways. Accordingly, museums are adopting new techniques and technologies to meet the diverse demands of visitors.
To help visitors interact with artworks and artists in a novel, engaging way, many museums are adopting technology to enhance the experience of museum-goers. The Van Gogh Museum in Amsterdam allows visitors to virtually touch objects and interact with the characters inside, immersing themselves in the artworks.
Some museums are even personalizing services, as natural language processing techniques can be implemented into chatbots. The chatbot of the British Museum of London explains details not only about the exhibits but also about the facilities and venues, in a dozen different languages.
Personalized services will continue to be an important part of a museum visitor's experience. Based on an analysis of a visitors' background and past behavior, including the artworks, websites, or social media sites they've viewed or given a "like" to online, deep learning systems can predict and recommend artworks they would most likely be interested in. The National Museum of Singapore conducted a study in 2017 on developing a deep learning engine that can track a visitor's gaze, identify what interests them, recommend personalized tours, and show them virtual objects on top of real-world exhibits, often giving interactive quizzes and games that suit their interests.
To some, visiting museums and galleries may be a way of escaping from everyday dullness. To others, it may be a serious attempt to enter a world of beauty, wonder, imagination, and inspiration. Whatever their reasons are, more visitors will seek a unique way of appreciating the exhibits, and more innovative services will emerge.

questions.passage: Museums are said to be places where time is (A)[transformed / transferred] into space. Maybe that's why people visit them, to learn and be inspired in new ways. Accordingly, museums are adopting new techniques and technologies to meet the (B)[diverse / uniform] demands of visitors. To help visitors interact with artworks and artists in a novel, engaging way, many museums are adopting technology to (C)[enhance / diminish] the experience of museum-goers.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① transformed–diverse–enhance: 모두 원문 그대로
❌ ② diminish(줄이다)는 경험 향상과 반대
❌ ③ transferred(이동하다)는 '변환'과 다름, uniform(동일한)은 다양한과 반대
❌ ④ 모두 원문 반대
det.tip: transform(변환하다) ↔ transfer(이동하다) / diverse(다양한) ↔ uniform(동일한) / enhance(향상시키다) ↔ diminish(줄이다)

questions.passage: Some museums are even personalizing services, as natural language processing techniques can be (A)[implemented / removed] into chatbots. The chatbot of the British Museum of London explains details not only about the (B)[exhibits / entrances] but also about the facilities and venues, in a dozen different languages. Based on an analysis of a visitors' background and past behavior, deep learning systems can (C)[predict / restrict] and recommend artworks they would most likely be interested in.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 자연어 처리 기술이 챗봇에 도입되고(implemented), 전시물(exhibits)에 대해 설명하고, 작품을 예측한다(predict).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ implemented–exhibits–predict: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ① restrict(제한하다)는 예측과 반대
❌ ② entrances(입구)는 전시물이 아님
❌ ③ removed(제거된)는 도입과 반대
det.tip: implement(도입하다) ↔ remove(제거하다) / exhibits(전시물) / predict(예측하다) ↔ restrict(제한하다)

questions.passage: The National Museum of Singapore conducted a study in 2017 on developing a deep learning engine that can (A)[track / ignore] a visitor's gaze, (B)[identify / conceal] what interests them, recommend personalized tours, and show them virtual objects on top of real-world exhibits, often giving interactive quizzes and games that (C)[suit / discourage] their interests.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 방문객의 시선을 추적하고(track), 관심사를 파악하고(identify), 관심사에 맞는(suit) 퀴즈와 게임을 제공한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② track–identify–suit: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ① discourage(저해하다)는 관심사에 맞추는 것과 반대
❌ ③ ignore(무시하다)는 시선 추적과 반대
❌ ④ conceal(숨기다)는 파악하기와 반대
det.tip: track(추적하다) ↔ ignore(무시하다) / identify(파악하다) ↔ conceal(숨기다) / suit(맞다) ↔ discourage(저해하다)

questions.passage: Museums are said to be places where time is transformed into space. Maybe that's why people visit them, to learn and be ①<u>inspired</u> in new ways. det.analysis:
✅ ③ boring(지루한) → engaging(흥미로운): 새로운 기술로 '흥미롭게' 상호작용하는 맥락
❌ ① inspired(영감을 받다): 적합
❌ ② diverse(다양한): 적합
❌ ④ enhance(향상시키다): 적합
det.tip: engaging(흥미로운, 참여하게 하는) ↔ boring(지루한)

questions.passage: Some museums are even personalizing services, as natural language processing techniques can be implemented into chatbots. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① ignore(무시하다) → predict(예측하다): 관심사를 '예측하여' 추천하는 맥락

❌ ③ identify(파악하다): 관심사 파악 적합
❌ ④ recommend(추천하다): 맞춤 투어 추천 적합
det.tip: predict(예측하다) ↔ ignore(무시하다) / predict and recommend = 예측하고 추천하다

questions.passage: To some, visiting museums and galleries may be a way of ①<u>escaping</u> from everyday dullness. To others, it may be a serious ②<u>attempt</u> to enter a world of beauty, wonder, imagination, and inspiration. Whatever their reasons are, more visitors will seek a ③<u>unique</u> way of appreciating the exhibits, and more ④<u>outdated</u> services will emerge.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ outdated(구식의) → innovative(혁신적인): 더 '혁신적인' 서비스가 등장한다는 맥락
❌ ① escaping(탈출하다): 일상 단조로움에서 탈출 적합
❌ ② attempt(시도): 진지한 시도 적합
❌ ③ unique(독특한): 독특한 감상 방식 적합
det.tip: innovative(혁신적인) ↔ outdated(구식의, 시대에 뒤떨어진)

questions.passage: Museums are said to be places where time is transformed into space. Maybe that's why people visit them, to learn and be inspired in new ways. questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 많은 박물관이 관람객의 경험을 향상시키기(enhance) 위해 기술을 도입한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② enhance(향상시키다): 새로운 기술로 경험 향상이라는 긍정적 맥락
❌ ① reduce(줄이다): 경험 향상과 반대
❌ ③ eliminate(제거하다): 경험 제거 부적합
❌ ④ avoid(피하다): 경험 회피 부적합
det.tip: enhance(향상시키다) ≈ improve, boost ↔ reduce, diminish

det.korean: 자연어 처리 기술이 챗봇에 도입될(implemented) 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ implemented(도입하다): 기술을 챗봇에 적용한다는 맥락
❌ ① exported(수출하다): 기술 도입과 무관
❌ ② excluded(배제하다): 도입과 반대
❌ ④ abolished(폐지하다): 도입과 반대
det.tip: implement(도입하다, 구현하다) ≈ apply, adopt / be implemented into = ~에 도입되다

questions.passage: Based on an analysis of a visitors' background and past behavior, deep learning systems can predict and recommend artworks they would most likely be interested in. questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 아름다움, 경이, 상상력, 그리고 영감(inspiration)의 세계에 들어가려는 시도.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ inspiration(영감): beauty, wonder, imagination과 병렬로 긍정적 가치
❌ ① destruction(파괴): 아름다움과 반대
❌ ② boredom(지루함): 탈출 대상이지 목적지 아님
❌ ③ monotony(단조로움): 일상 단조로움에서 벗어나려는 것
det.tip: beauty, wonder, imagination, inspiration — 모두 긍정적 가치의 병렬 나열

questions.passage: Museums are said to be places where time is transformed into space. Maybe that's why people visit them, to learn and be inspired in new ways. Accordingly, museums are adopting new techniques and technologies to meet the <u>diverse</u> demands of visitors.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 diverse와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① various(다양한): diverse의 동의어
❌ ② identical(동일한): 반의어
❌ ③ limited(제한된): 다양과 반대
❌ ④ singular(단수의): 다양과 반대
det.tip: diverse ≈ various ≈ varied ↔ identical, uniform

questions.passage: The National Museum of Singapore <u>conducted</u> a study in 2017 on developing a deep learning engine that can track a visitor's gaze, identify what interests them, recommend personalized tours, and show them virtual objects on top of real-world exhibits.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 conducted와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② carried out(수행하다): conducted의 동의어
❌ ① maintained(유지하다): 수행과 다름
❌ ③ canceled(취소하다): 반의어
❌ ④ avoided(피하다): 반의어
det.tip: conduct ≈ carry out = 수행하다, 실시하다

questions.passage: Whatever their reasons are, more visitors will seek a unique way of appreciating the exhibits, and more innovative services will <u>emerge</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 emerge와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ appear(나타나다): emerge의 동의어
❌ ① disappear(사라지다): 반의어
❌ ② decline(감소하다): 등장과 반대
❌ ④ vanish(사라지다): 반의어
det.tip: emerge ≈ appear = 등장하다, 나타나다 ↔ disappear, vanish

questions.passage: To some, visiting museums and galleries may be a way of escaping from everyday <u>dullness</u>. To others, it may be a serious attempt to enter a world of beauty, wonder, imagination, and inspiration.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 dullness와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ excitement(흥분, 설렘): dullness(단조로움)의 반의어
❌ ① tedium(지루함): dullness의 유의어
❌ ② monotony(단조로움): dullness의 유의어
❌ ③ routine(일상): dullness와 유사
det.tip: dullness(단조로움, 지루함) ↔ excitement(흥분, 설렘)

questions.passage: Whatever their reasons are, more visitors will seek a unique way of appreciating the exhibits, and more <u>innovative</u> services will emerge.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 innovative와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① conventional(전통적인, 관습적인): innovative의 반의어
❌ ② creative(창의적인): innovative의 유의어
❌ ③ original(독창적인): innovative의 유의어
❌ ④ advanced(진보된): innovative의 유사어
det.tip: innovative(혁신적인) ↔ conventional(전통적인, 관습적인)

questions.passage:
(A) The National Museum of Singapore conducted a study on developing a deep learning engine that can track a visitor's gaze, identify what interests them, recommend personalized tours, and show them virtual objects, often giving interactive quizzes and games that <u>suit</u> their interests.

(B) Whatever their reasons are, more visitors will <u>seek</u> a unique way of appreciating the exhibits, and more innovative services will emerge.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 suit와 seek의 의미로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 관심사에 어울리는(suit) 퀴즈. (B) 독특한 감상 방법을 추구할(seek) 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 어울리다–추구하다: (A) suit = 어울리다/맞다, (B) seek = 찾다/추구하다
❌ ① 머무르다: seek의 의미와 다름
❌ ② 소송하다: suit의 법률 용어 의미, 문맥 부적합
❌ ④ 모두 부적합
det.tip: suit: 정장, 소송, 어울리다 등 다의어 / seek: 찾다, 추구하다, 구하다

questions.stem:
다음 영영 풀이에 해당하는 단어는?
"to involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or experience"

det.analysis:
✅ ④ immerse(몰입하다): 영영 풀이와 정확히 일치
❌ ① interact(상호작용하다): 깊이 몰입과 다름
❌ ② enhance(향상시키다): 경험 개선이지 몰입 아님
❌ ③ emerge(등장하다): 나타남이지 몰입 아님
det.tip: immerse ≈ absorb = 몰입하다 / immersing themselves in = ~에 몰입하여

questions.passage: Based on an analysis of a visitors' background and past behavior, deep learning systems can predict and recommend artworks they would most likely be interested in. The museum can also recommend __________ (personalize) tours based on each visitor's preferences.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: 각 방문객의 취향에 맞춘 개인화된(personalized) 투어를 추천한다.
det.analysis: tours를 수식하는 형용사 역할 필요. personalize → personalized(과거분사, 형용사).
det.tip: personalize(개인화하다) → personalized(개인화된) / personalized tours = 맞춤형 투어

questions.passage: The Van Gogh Museum in Amsterdam allows visitors to virtually touch objects and interact with the characters inside, __________ (immerse) themselves in the artworks.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.analysis: 분사구문: 동시동작/결과를 나타내는 현재분사. immerse → immersing.
det.tip: , immersing = ~하면서, 그래서 ~하며 (동시동작 분사구문) / immerse oneself in = ~에 몰입하다
